parameters.query:
INSERT INTO scopeledger.cases (project_id, mailbox_id, message_id, request_excerpt, state)
VALUES (
  $1::uuid,
  $2,
  $3,
  $4,
  'investigating'
)
ON CONFLICT (mailbox_id, message_id)
DO UPDATE SET updated_at = now()
RETURNING id, project_id, mailbox_id, message_id, state, evidence_version, row_version;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.body.project_id || '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111', $json.body.mailbox_id || 'mailbox-01', $json.body.message_id || ('msg-' + Date.now()), $json.body.request_body || 'Client requests scope swap for Account Dashboard.'] }}

parameters.query:
SELECT sv.id as active_scope_id, sv.version, sv.normalized_scope, p.repo_owner, p.repo_name, p.currency
FROM scopeledger.projects p
JOIN scopeledger.scope_versions sv ON sv.id = p.active_scope_id
WHERE p.id = $1::uuid;

UPDATE scopeledger.cases
SET recommendation = $1::jsonb,
    state = 'awaiting_manager',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $2::uuid
RETURNING id, state, recommendation;
